invariants.description: phi_CO2_dyn matches its exact solution dot_C_CO2_a tau_CO2_cc_dyn (1 - exp(-t/tau_cap))
phi_stat and f_c_stat follow the static O2-CO2 interaction law (zero below C_CO2_a_nom)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(f_c_stat - np.where(C_CO2_a >= C_CO2_a_nom, K_stat*(1 - np.exp(-(K_CO2*(C_CO2_a - C_CO2_a_nom)*K_O2*(1 - np.exp(-X_O2/K_O2)))/K_stat)), 0.0))) <= 1e-8*max(1.0, K_stat)

invariants.description: with dC_CO2/dt = 0, phi_apc matches the exact solution f_c_stat (1 - exp(-t/tau_cap))
S_O2_a lies in [0, 1] and P_O2_a is positive at the physiological run point

bc_sweep.rationale: C_O2_a 0.10-0.204 ml/ml spans severe hypoxaemia (PaO2 ~ 25 mmHg) to full saturation just below the capping level C_O2_sat*saturation_cap; C_CO2_a 0.30-0.60 ml/ml spans hypocapnia to marked hypercapnia around the normal 0.485; dC_CO2/dt +-0.002 /s (a 0.1 ml/ml change over ~50 s, a fast hypercapnic step); saturation_cap is a numerical guard (<1). Other constants 0.5-2x nominal.

baseline.reason: Candidate: steady-state carotid-body firing vs PaO2 at several PaCO2 levels (the data MagossoUrsino2001 fitted the O2-CO2 interaction to). Requires the paper/figure (paywalled); not set up.
